Decal.name: Decal
Decal.description: Drop-in surface decal for impact prefabs (bullet holes, scorches, burns...). Add it to the prefab that is spawned at the impact point. That prefab must be positioned on the surface and facing along its normal (+Z outward) — which is exactly how hitFX / SurfaceFXManager orient their prefabs via lookAt(point + normal). On spawn it finds the surface mesh underneath and builds a conforming decal out of that mesh's own triangles (three's DecalGeometry), so the mark follows curved hulls (spaceships, cars) instead of being a flat quad. The decal is parented to the surface it hit, so it stays put — and rides along if the surface moves — even after the rest of the impact FX is removed by SelfDestroy. Skinned meshes are not conformed (their pose can't be baked cheaply) and get a flat sticker instead.
